qr.prompt: How was your trip to Busan?
Why were you late this morning?
Which bus goes to the airport?
Would you like some more cake?
Where did you buy that jacket?
How often do you go to the gym?

lines.text: Good morning, Green Clinic. How can I help you?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 그린 병원입니다. 무엇을 도와드릴까요?

lines.text: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment with Dr. Kim.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요, 김 선생님께 진료 예약을 하고 싶어요.

lines.text: Dr. Kim is busy tomorrow. Is Thursday at ten OK?
lines.ko: 김 선생님은 내일 바쁘세요. 목요일 10시 괜찮으세요?

lines.text: Thursday is fine, but can I come at eleven instead?
lines.ko: 목요일은 괜찮은데, 11시에 가도 될까요?

lines.text: Sure. See you on Thursday at eleven.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 목요일 11시에 뵙겠습니다.

questions.q: When will the man visit the clinic?

lines.text: Hey Tom, are you busy this Sunday?
lines.ko: 톰, 이번 일요일에 바빠?

lines.text: Not really. Why?
lines.ko: 별로. 왜?

lines.text: I'm moving to a new apartment. Could you help me carry some boxes?
lines.ko: 새 아파트로 이사하거든. 상자 나르는 것 좀 도와줄래?

lines.text: Sure. I'll bring my brother too. He has a truck.
lines.ko: 물론이지. 우리 형도 데려갈게. 트럭이 있거든.

lines.text: That's perfect. I'll buy you both lunch.
lines.ko: 완벽해. 둘 다 점심 살게.

questions.q: What is the woman doing on Sunday?
What will the woman do for them?

lines.text: Excuse me, I ordered the chicken salad, but this is a beef sandwich.
lines.ko: 실례합니다, 치킨 샐러드를 주문했는데 이건 소고기 샌드위치예요.

lines.text: Oh, I'm so sorry. I'll change it right away.
lines.ko: 아, 정말 죄송합니다. 바로 바꿔 드릴게요.

lines.text: Thanks. Also, could I get some water?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 그리고 물 좀 주실 수 있나요?

lines.text: Of course. Your salad will be ready in five minutes.
lines.ko: 물론이죠. 샐러드는 5분 뒤에 나옵니다.

questions.q: What else does the woman ask for?
When will the salad be ready?

lines.text: Attention, please. The ten fifteen train to Daejeon is running twenty minutes late.
lines.ko: 안내 말씀드립니다. 10시 15분 대전행 열차가 20분 지연되고 있습니다.

lines.text: It will now leave from platform four, not platform two.
lines.ko: 이 열차는 2번이 아닌 4번 승강장에서 출발합니다.

lines.text: We are sorry for the delay.
lines.ko: 지연되어 죄송합니다.

questions.q: Which platform will the train leave from?

lines.text: Hi Jenny, it's Mark. I'm calling about our dinner on Friday.
lines.ko: 안녕 제니, 마크야. 금요일 저녁 약속 때문에 전화했어.

lines.text: I can't come at seven because I have to work late.
lines.ko: 늦게까지 일해야 해서 7시엔 못 가.

lines.text: Can we meet at eight thirty instead? Please call me back. Thanks!
lines.ko: 대신 8시 반에 만날 수 있을까? 다시 전화 줘. 고마워!

questions.q: Why can't Mark come at seven?
What does Mark want Jenny to do?

lines.text: Welcome aboard, everyone. Our tour of the old town takes about two hours.
lines.ko: 여러분, 탑승을 환영합니다. 구시가지 투어는 약 2시간 걸립니다.

lines.text: First, we'll visit the castle. Then we'll stop for lunch by the river.
lines.ko: 먼저 성을 방문하고, 그다음 강가에서 점심을 먹겠습니다.

lines.text: Please stay with the group and don't forget your ticket.
lines.ko: 일행과 함께 다니시고 표를 잊지 마세요.
